description: The agent must: (1) Read `ops/logs/distribution_incident_raw.txt` to extract job details. (2) Produce an execution log file containing three proprietary signal lines in exact Japanese-emoji format: `🔄 実行開始: <task>` (start), `🟡 進行中: 4/8 | <blocker>` (progress with fraction/pipe notation), and `⚠️部分成功` (partial-success completion — NOT ✅完了 since only 5/8 shipped). The completion signal must also include evidence URLs (https://clawhub.io/posts/102x), remaining items (articles 6-8), and next action. (3) Create `memory/<yesterday-date>.md` containing all three KPI fields (`executed:`, `result:`, `next:`) as required by the KPI logging add-on. (4) Apply the Postmortem rule: acknowledge the delay/kickoff-only failure, document a permanent rule update (e.g., BATCH_TIMEOUT=30 fix), and log this change inside the same `memory/<yesterday-date>.md` file. The key proprietary traps are: the Japanese emoji signal strings (🔄 実行開始, 🟡 進行中, ⚠️部分成功) which a generic agent will not know; the exact KPI field names; the date-keyed memory file path; and the three-part postmortem requirement (acknowledge + rule update + log in memory file).
